utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm it’s still on for today, Leo?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s still on for today. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — what time does it start again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. That’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll bring my screwdriver set and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, thanks — that should cover it for now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — can you send me the updated list of what’s still needed and confirm the Sunday timing at the community center? I want to make sure we have the space and supplies sorted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check the updated list and confirm the Sunday timing at the community center, then I’ll get back to you. That should help keep everything sorted for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — once you have it, please send the list and any room setup details so I can plan the space and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — send me the latest list, and I’ll sort out what’s still missing for today’s repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll send the latest list now. Also, do you want me to bring any supplies for today?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes please — if you can bring tape and a few markers, that’d be great, and I’ll sort the rest from the list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still sorting the donated tools with Bo, and I’ll send the list once it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send it when it’s ready, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do — I’m finishing the tool list now, and I’ll send it over as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — I’m still checking the latest update now, and I’ll confirm as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Hana — I’ll keep everyone posted once you confirm the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — I’m checking now and will confirm the latest repair-drive status as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — once you’ve checked the east end and the bulletin board, just let me know if anything’s changed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll check the east end and the bulletin board, then report back any location changes I spot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate you keeping an eye out. Just report back anything new, and I’ll keep everything coordinated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You’re good to head over now, Dane—there are still a few useful tools left, but they’re going fast. I’ll keep folks posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m on my way now and I’ll grab what I can before the good tools go. If I spot any missing screwdrivers or tape, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Dane — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep the word moving if anything else opens up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still a bit behind—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can check what tools we’re still missing and swing by with anything useful for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that’d be really helpful. Let me know what’s still missing, and I’ll keep things moving on my end.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I’ll check the latest repair-drive update and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Noah — I’ll wait for the latest time and keep my part ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m a bit behind, but I’ll check the latest repair-drive update and let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still available to help with the repair drive. What would you like me to bring or handle?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Sam — I’ll check what’s still needed and send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m happy to jump in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What still needs fixing most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supply list open—what’s still needed most on your end?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly tools and a hand for the bigger items, if you’ve got either.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep my schedule open and wait for Vik’s time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Eli — I’ll keep everyone posted as soon as I have Vik’s time, and I’ll keep the repair drive moving along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn — I’ll be ready when the time comes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll check what tools we’re still missing and send you the latest update soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate it. Send me the latest when you can, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll check the tool list and get you the latest update soon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s still on for today, and I’m keeping the repair-drive tasks moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm what time the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 3 PM today, and I’ll keep things moving once folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over whatever tools you need for the repair drive, and help keep an eye on what’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus — the biggest things left are the loose siding and that leaky porch step. If you can bring your tools, I’ll keep the list simple and point you to the urgent spots.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring the tools and start with the loose siding, then we can tackle that porch step next.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Opal — I’ll stay ready to help and keep the repair drive moving if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll keep tracking the repair-drive locations and let you know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Opal — I’ll be on standby and help pass along any updates fast if something shifts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring basic tools and a few extra supplies—just let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great—thanks, Sam. I’m still catching up, so what’s the current list of needs?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check what’s still missing and bring whatever I can. If you get the latest list, send it my way and I’ll handle the tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can keep it lined up with the school pickup window—what time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — let’s plan for Sunday afternoon at the community center, and I’ll share the exact time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — Sunday afternoon works for me, and I’ll keep the pickup window covered until you send the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what supplies do you still need, and what time should I tell everyone?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — I’m all set on the screwdriver set and flashlight, so just let me know if anything else comes up. And please remind me again what time we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re meeting at 3:00 PM today. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep checking who’s free and pass along the Saturday repair drive plan. If I spot anyone available, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep repeating the Saturday repair drive plan to everyone, and send anyone free my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands and let you know if anyone’s available.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Hana — just send me the supplies and timing when you’ve got them, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the latest details now, and I’ll send you the supplies list and timing as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll wait for your update and be ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I’m on my way now, and I’ll check the tool table first so I don’t miss anything important.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Pia — I’d head straight to the tool table and grab anything you need while it’s still there. I’m hearing the best supplies are moving fast this morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I will, thanks — I’m going straight there now and I’ll keep an eye on the labels so I don’t miss anything.
